name: Drudge Fort
title: Drudge Fort
summary: A huge wooden fort near Cragstone, 'quite full of Drudges' since Prodigal Sons; destructible doors guard the way to the central house (Sergeant Shanks, Hoogan) and the Drudge Fort Cave. In the kit: a 210 m hilltop fort of concentric square timber palisades (17 m wall models) stepping up the hill from z 67 to the inner courtyard at z 84, four 17 m wooden towers round the courtyard, 24 tiki torches flanking the gates, three Drudge Bonfires in the courtyard and more outside, and the central house and two-storey hall.

landmarks.name: Inner courtyard and central hall (0x01000BC3)
landmarks.note: Two-storey hall where Sergeant Shanks stands, the central house 0x010011A9 (35507,30557) and three Drudge Bonfires.

landmarks.name: South gate
landmarks.note: Gate in the outer palisade (0x01004010, top z 80.9) flanked by torches at (35503.2,30441.1) and (35513.2,30441.3).

landmarks.name: Outside bonfire
landmarks.note: Drudge Bonfire spawn 31 m south of the south gate.

site.name: Drudge Fort
site.notes: No outdoor gazetteer teleport at the fort (gazetteer has only the Drudge Fort Cave dungeon and a portal 198 m away); derived @teleloc on open grass 160 m south-south-east of the fort, outside the outer palisade (ground z 55.7).

shots.standingOrder: Arc slowly clockwise 160 m out and 60 m above the courtyard round the drudges' wooden fort, its concentric palisades stepping up to the bonfire courtyard; hold 15 m above every crown.
